title: GREED
description:
GREED is a PSX styled FPS designed for replayability through speedrunning. 

Inspired by the best shooters of the '90s and today, such as DOOM, ULTRAKILL, and the original Half-Life. 

• Watch your enemies fall to the ground and crush their skulls.

• Defeat enemies big and small with your onslaught of weapons.

• Replay levels to master them and achieve better times (for bragging rights).

• Explore multiple environments all with their own enemies.

• Rid the world of greed and take back heaven.
description_short: GREED is a PSX styled FPS designed for replayability through speedrunning. Inspired by the best shooters of the '90s and today, watch your enemies fall to the ground and crush their skulls with your onslaught of weapons. Do you have what it takes to stop greed and take back heaven?
